description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'MatriculaController' which handles HTTP requests related to course enrollment ('matricula') for authenticated users. It provides a method to save a matricula (enrollment) by course ID and user information, utilizing services and repositories, and rendering appropriate views.

classes.name: MatriculaController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing course enrollment operations for authenticated users.

methods.name: saveMatricula
methods.description: Handles GET requests to save a course enrollment given the course ID, retrieving user info from authentication, and updating the model for the success or error view.
